A ZF data box takes a ZFW / ZFCG of its own for the CG targeting (ZFW 270-373 t, ZFCG 23-48 %, both needed), written to `L:A32NX_FUEL_REFUEL_ZFW` (kg) and `L:A32NX_FUEL_REFUEL_ZFCG` (% MAC); FQMS DEFAULT clears it (0).
REFUEL after SET of a ZFW 300 t / ZFCG 36.5 % entry

items: The ZF entry does not change the refuel yet. Why: The fuel system side that reads it (FQMS CG targeting with the REFUEL ZF data, FUEL REFUEL DATA / FMS DISAGREE) is on a separate branch, not merged. What to do: None.
No entry in flight. Why: Design choice: refuel is a ground function. What to do: None.
On the ground: NEW PFQ, SET. For the ZF data: ZFW and ZFCG, SET; FQMS DEFAULT to remove them.

children.title: T.O PERF, LOADSHEET and LDG PERF

items: T.O PERF: CONDITIONS, a runway of the departure airport, COMPUTE: speeds, flaps, FLEX or derate, MTOW(perf), from the shared A380 takeoff calculator (the flyPad's). XCHECK WITH AVNCS compares them with the FMS T.O page, the SD gross weight and the captain's QNH and lists the discrepancies in amber.

LOADSHEET (REDUCED mode): TOW/CG, LW/CG, underload and T.O THS from the ZFW/CG and the fuel; LTS EDITION, GENERATE, PRINT (titled LOADSHEET) and EXPORT to the EXPORT BOX. Its TOW and LW go to T.O PERF and LDG PERF.
LDG PERF: DISPATCH and IN-FLIGHT landing distance, stop margin, MLW(perf), VAPP and go-around data for a runway of the destination.
The entries and results stay while the application is open.

blocks.text: T.O PERF computed at LFBO RWY 14
XCHECK WITH AVNCS with nothing in the FMS: every item in amber
LOADSHEET after GENERATE
LDG PERF computed
PRINT, MULTIPLE RWY, the DETAILED loadsheet, REFUEL ZF DATA, MORE and ACFT STS: see "Performance applications" below.

items: Nothing goes to the FMS. Why: As on the aircraft: XCHECK only compares. What to do: Enter the values in the MFD.

Above the 10 kt tailwind limit LDG PERF still computes, without a mark. Why: The shared calculator continues the tailwind correction of the data and flags the result; the OIT page does not show that flag (as on develop). What to do: Treat a result with more than 10 kt of tailwind as extrapolated.
FLT OPS STS: flight number and airports. LOADSHEET: ZFW/CG and fuel, COMPUTE, LTS EDITION, GENERATE.
T.O PERF: conditions and runway (TOW comes from the loadsheet), COMPUTE, then XCHECK WITH AVNCS.
LDG PERF: conditions and runway, COMPUTE.

blocks.text: The electronic technical logbook: STATUS (release, open / deferred / temporary / cabin items), LOGBOOK ENTRY (ECAM alerts, cabin items, system & function, cockpit interface, keyword, free text), HISTORY and FLIGHT DATA; PIC ACCEPT with the acceptance report and CLOSE FLIGHT with the closure report; UPDATE / GIVE BACK TO GROUND synchronise with a simulated ground. Design choice: the ground defers some defects by ATA chapter (MEL B/C/D, CDL, OTHER) with an expiry and rectifies the others. The logbook is kept across flights; STATUS, the acceptance report and FLIGHT DATA print with their titles.
STATUS
LOGBOOK ENTRY
After UPDATE with the ground
DEFERRED ITEMS: a defect deferred under the MEL with its expiry

items: The ground is simulated. Why: There is no maintenance organisation behind the logbook. What to do: None.
Some UX gaps: the password field may need a second click, NIL is not clickable, PERSONAL ID is not kept between signatures. Why: Known, not fixed yet. What to do: Click the field again.
Open LOGBOOK, sign in with a personal ID and password.
Check STATUS and the items, open the flight, PIC ACCEPT. Record defects in LOGBOOK ENTRY; CLOSE FLIGHT at the end; UPDATE to synchronise with the ground.

children.title: LOAD BOX, EXPORT BOX and IN-FLT PERF ATMO

items: LOAD BOX: the flight folder sent from the ground, here your SimBrief OFP of the flyPad, with its loading status per laptop; LOAD loads the ticked items.
EXPORT BOX: items to send to the ground (a loaded flight folder, an exported loadsheet), GND tick and SEND; on the ground the gatelink sends them, else they wait in the outbox.

IN-FLT PERF ATMO: speed conversions (IAS, Mach, TAS, GS), ISA information, true altitude and low altitude temperature corrections. The FCOM describes only ATMO; CLB, CRZ, DES, HLD and PLAN are greyed.

blocks.text: LOAD BOX (no SimBrief OFP loaded in the flyPad)
EXPORT BOX with an exported loadsheet
IN-FLT PERF ATMO

items: Every airport has a gatelink. Why: Design choice: no airport database of gatelinks. What to do: None.
GROSS WGHT of ATMO is not used. Why: No ATMO computation needs it; the field is kept for the FCOM layout. What to do: None.
Load a SimBrief OFP in the flyPad, LOAD BOX > REFRESH LOAD BOX, tick it, LOAD.
EXPORT BOX: tick GND, SEND (on the ground).
IN-FLT PERF > ATMO: conditions and specific data, COMPUTE.

children.title: FLT OPS STS filled from the FMS and shared by the CAPT and F/O laptops

items: FLT NBR, FROM and TO fill themselves from the FMS (flight number and city pair) until the crew types an entry; SYNCHRO AVIONICS takes the FMS values again and follows them anew.

The CAPT and F/O laptops show the same page: a manual entry, SYNCHRO AVIONICS and EXIT SESSION on one laptop reach the other one; a laptop that joins the FLT OPS network takes the page of the other laptop. EXIT SESSION clears both laptops' page.

The FMS data reach a laptop that runs on the FLT OPS network with an NSS AVNCS server and the avionics link of the NSS AVNCS side (not both SCIs lost). Without them the page keeps its entries, and SYNCHRO AVIONICS does not reload the flight plan of the EFB overlay either.
OIS VERSION shows the build of the aircraft; the registration list comes from the ATC ID.

blocks.text: CAPT laptop: FLT OPS STS filled from the FMS
CAPT laptop showing the entry made on the F/O laptop

items: A stand-alone laptop gets nothing. Why: Design choice: off the network it gets no avionics data and no exchange (SYNCHRONIZATION NOT AVAIL). What to do: None.
An entry typed on a laptop that has just joined can be overwritten by the other laptop's answer. Why: A one-frame window while the two laptops exchange their pages. What to do: Type the entry again.
Enter the flight number and the airports in the MFD: FLT OPS STS fills itself on both laptops.
Type an entry on one laptop to override the FMS; SYNCHRO AVIONICS to take the FMS values again.

children.title: NSS DATA TO AVNCS OFF and both SCIs lost on the OIS

items: With NSS DATA TO AVNCS OFF or both SCIs lost the NSS AVNCS side cannot send data to the avionics: the REFUEL entries (NEW PFQ, ZF data, FQMS DEFAULT) are not sent to the FQMS and REFUEL says NOT SENT: NSS DATA TO AVNCS INOP; the NSS AVNCS message toolbar shows the INOP system.
Both SCIs lost also cut the eLogbook ground link (UPDATE / GIVE BACK TO GROUND fail) and the avionics data (the FLT OPS STS page keeps its entries).
The AOC itself stops receiving while it is off (on `core/a380x-ois-datalink`).

blocks.text: REFUEL with NSS DATA TO AVNCS OFF: NOT SENT
FLT OPS STS with both SCIs lost

items: No COMPANY MSG memo / voice change and no COM NSS DATA TO AVNCS XFR FAULT alert on this branch. Why: The FWS part of this change needs FWS alerts that are on develop only. What to do: None.
Leave NSS DATA TO AVNCS in its normal position; with OFF, enter the refuel on the refuel panel.

blocks.text: The AOC prints the weather reports it receives (METAR, TAF, ATIS) by itself on the pedestal printer. `L:A32NX_COMPANY_MSG_PRNTR_COUNT` counts the ones waiting for their printout until they are printed or read; on develop the COMPANY MSG memo then reads COMPANY MSG:PRNTR.

items: Only the weather reports print by themselves. Why: User choice: the other company messages are printed with PRINT. What to do: None.
With the printer off the message waits until it is read. Why: The printer must acknowledge the printout. What to do: Switch the printer on.
Request a METAR in COMPANY COM: the answer prints by itself.

children.title: Performance applications: PRINT, MULTIPLE RWY, DETAILED loadsheet, REFUEL ZF DATA, MORE, ACFT STS

items: PRINT in FUNCTIONS of T.O PERF and LDG PERF prints the results under the title of the application. STORE stays greyed (no EFF to store into).
MULTIPLE RWY COMPUTATION (T.O PERF, LDG PERF): tick runways of the airport, COMPUTE them at once and pick each result in the colour-coded RWY list.

LOADSHEET REFUEL ZF DATA: FQMS DEFAULT, NEW SET OF DATA (the REFUEL application's data) or LOADSHEET (default), with the fuel distribution of the FQMS CG targeting. MORE: the TOCG warning and the automatic ground transfer to the CG limit and to the refuel target.
LOADSHEET DETAILED: crew, passengers and cargo with their distribution in the cabin and the holds, and the detailed loadsheet with its edition number.
ACFT STS and SYNCHRO LOGBOOK: the deferred MEL and CDL items of the technical logbook, with the items the computation cannot take into account ("n ITEMS NOT IN COMPUTATION, SEE ACFT STS").

blocks.text: T.O PERF: MULTIPLE RWY with four runways, the MEL / CDL items of ACFT STS
LDG PERF with ACFT STS
LOADSHEET REFUEL ZF DATA
LOADSHEET MORE panel
LOADSHEET DETAILED: payload distribution

items: STORE is greyed. Why: There is no electronic flight folder to store the results into. What to do: Use PRINT.
Items the computation cannot take into account are listed, not computed. Why: The shared performance calculators have no MEL / CDL corrections. What to do: Apply them by hand.
T.O PERF / LDG PERF: MULTIPLE RWY COMPUTATION tab, tick the runways, COMPUTE, pick a runway in the RWY list; FUNCTIONS > PRINT.
LOADSHEET: ENTRY MODE DETAILED for crew / passengers / cargo; REFUEL ZF DATA tab for the FQMS ZF data; MORE for the TOCG and the ground transfer.
SYNCHRO LOGBOOK, then ACFT STS, to see the deferred items.

children.title: NSS GATELINK pb-sw, reset recovery and the NSS shutdown on lost AC power

items: The GATELINK pb-sw (`L:A32NX_OVHD_NSS_GATELINK_OFF`) works: with it OFF the EXPORT BOX has no gatelink and the LOAD BOX gets no data from the ground.
Reset recovery: an OIT that is restarted (BRIGHTNESS knob OFF for 5 s) or a laptop that is restarted (OFF for 30 s) clears an injected failure of that device.

NSS shutdown: each NSS ANSU shuts itself down 10 s after the AC busbar that feeds it is lost, but only when that busbar was supplied once (power that was on and is lost). A flight load, where the busbars report late, therefore no longer restarts the ARU or leaves the FLT OPS laptop stand-alone.

The ARU start follows the flyPad start-up time setting (INSTANT 0 s, FAST 5 s, REAL 120 s, the default) and needs a healthy FLT OPS ANSU; a flight load gets a 10 s window in which an already running laptop is kept.
The GATELINK has no picture of its own. Why: Its effect is the absence of data in the LOAD BOX and of the gatelink in the EXPORT BOX. What to do: Check the two applications.
Press the GATELINK pb-sw OFF to cut the ground link; set the OIT BRIGHTNESS knob to OFF for 5 s (OIT) or 30 s (laptop) to restart the device.

children.title: Laptop keyboard: function keys, CTRL / ALT latch, brightness gate

items: The function keys press the OIT buttons that show them (COMPUTE ‹F8>, the tabs ‹F2> and ‹Ctrl F2>...).
CTRL and ALT latch for the next key, because the 3D keyboard has no chords: the key lamp stays lit while the modifier is latched, then the menu shortcut (Ctrl P, Alt H...) is sent.
The OIT BRIGHTNESS knob at OFF also switches off the keyboard and the ACD.
COMPANY COM and LOGBOOK start at the NSS AVNCS log-on.

blocks.text: T.O PERF with the tabs and their shortcuts
COMPUTE ‹F8> pressed from the keyboard

items: A latched CTRL or ALT has one lamp only. Why: The key has a single lamp: it is lit while latched and dark otherwise. What to do: Press the next key; the latch clears after it.
Press F8 in T.O PERF to COMPUTE; press CTRL, then F2, for the MULTIPLE RWY tab.

children.title: LOGBOOK usability: PERSONAL ID, STORE IN, UPDATE / GIVE BACK messages

items: An accepted identification or signature keeps the typed PERSONAL ID for the next signature of the same log-on; CANCEL drops it; the password is never kept.
STORE IN shows OPEN ITEMS until the crew chooses (design choice: the FCOM figures show either storage selected, none preselected).
The end of an UPDATE or GIVE BACK synchronisation gives a plain message.
The input fields (shared with the MFD and the ND) release the previous field before the next one takes focus, so the field just selected keeps the keyboard.

blocks.text: LOGBOOK: message at the end of an UPDATE

items: The end-of-synchronisation messages are our wording. Why: The manual shows no message there. What to do: None.
Log on, sign an entry, then sign the next one: the PERSONAL ID is still typed.

children.title: LOADSHEET fuel distribution modes and the CG diagram

items: LOADSHEET FUEL DISTR offers TRIM ADJUSTMENT and MANUAL DISTR next to CG TARGETING.

MANUAL DISTR must equal the FOB exactly (the FCOM allows no tolerance). A tank box that still shows the value computed before keeps the exact quantity, so a displayed value typed back raises no error.
The MORE panel draws the CG diagram with the DOW, ZFW, TOW and LW points.

blocks.text: TRIM ADJUSTMENT
MANUAL DISTR with the sum equal to the FOB
LOADSHEET MORE: the CG diagram

items: No tolerance on MANUAL DISTR. Why: The FCOM requires the manual distribution to be identical to the FOB. What to do: Type the distribution so that the sum equals the FOB.
LOADSHEET > FUEL DISTR: choose the mode, enter the values, COMPUTE; MORE for the diagram.

children.title: AOC: OOOI reports, message ZOOM, Flight Delay and Flight Parameters reports

items: The AOC sends the OOOI reports (OUT, OFF, ON, IN) by itself to the OOOI station set on the COMPANY COM Flight Log page.
COMPANY COM Inbox, Outbox and Sent have a ZOOM button: the displayed message in larger characters.
In-flight Reports: new Flight Delay and Flight Parameters report forms.

blocks.text: Flight Delay report form
Outbox message with ZOOM

items: The OOOI reports go to one station. Why: The station is the one set on the Flight Log page. What to do: Set it before the flight.
Set the OOOI station on the Flight Log page; fly: OUT, OFF, ON and IN are sent. Open a message and press ZOOM.

children.title: A380X COMPANY MSG memo and voice
COMPANY MSG memo and voice gating, COMPANY MSG:PRNTR

blocks.text: The A380 FCOM (DSC-46-20-20-80/85, DSC-46-40, ECAM memos) says the AOC raises its memos and voices through the secure communication interfaces (SCI), in the NSS to avionics direction. When that direction is cut, the crew gets no message indication. The FWS now follows it:

items: No COMPANY MSG memo and no COMPANY MESSAGE voice while the NSS DATA TO AVNCS pb-sw is OFF (alert COM NSS DATA TO AVNCS XFR FAULT) or both SCIs are lost (COM NSS/AVNCS DATA XFR FAULT). A message received during that time is not announced later.

COMPANY MSG:PRNTR replaces the COMPANY MSG memo while unread company messages (received weather reports: METAR, TAF, ATIS) wait for their automatic printout on the pedestal printer. The count is L:A32NX_COMPANY_MSG_PRNTR_COUNT, written by the AOC auto-print of `core/a380x-ois`; the memo goes back to COMPANY MSG, or off, once they are printed or read.
A company message arrives, link normal: COMPANY MSG memo and the COMPANY MESSAGE voice (the voice stays inhibited in the usual flight phases).
A weather report arrives and waits for its printout: COMPANY MSG:PRNTR; it goes when the report is printed.
NSS DATA TO AVNCS OFF or both SCIs lost: COM NSS DATA TO AVNCS XFR FAULT or COM NSS/AVNCS DATA XFR FAULT; no COMPANY MSG memo, no voice for new messages.

Needs the AOC print and the weather requests of `core/a380x-ois` for the PRNTR memo. Why: It is written by that branch; without a count of 0 the memo stays COMPANY MSG. What to do: Merged in this branch.
The alerts and the ATA 46 flyPad failures come from `core/a380x-elec-fuel-alerts`. Why: The gate reads those two alerts. What to do: Merged in this branch.
The OIT, REFUEL, logbook and AOC effects of the same NSS DATA TO AVNCS OFF / SCI loss change are not part of this branch. Why: They are on `core/a380x-ois` and `core/a380x-ois-datalink`.
Nothing to set: the memo follows the NSS DATA TO AVNCS pb-sw and the SCIs.
To read a message, open COMPANY COM on the OIT or the MFD AOC pages; the PRNTR memo goes when the printout is done.

blocks.text: Setup: A380X on the ground with the AOC working (`core/a380x-ois` and Hoppie network for weather requests), pedestal printer with paper.

SMOKE warnings (the main / upper avionics bay logic is in the FWS), by the AGENT TO FWD (AFT) pb SMOKE lights for the cargo compartments, and by the SMOKE light of the NSS MASTER sw for the NSS (A380 FCOM DSC-46-20-20-87, no ECAM alert)

A32NX_SMOKE_DETECTION_FUNCTION_FAULT - Bool - True when the Smoke Detection Function (SDF) itself is failed (flyPad failure "Smoke detection function (SDF) of the CIDS", 26048): no compartment then reports smoke or a detector fault (A32NX_SMOKE_{zone}_DETECTED and A32NX_SMOKE_{zone}_DET_FAULT stay false). Written by systems fire_and_smoke_protection.rs, drives the FWS SMOKE DET FAULT caution (A380 FCOM PRO-ABN-ECAM-10-26)
A32NX_CARGOSMOKE_{FWD | AFT}_DISCHARGED - Bool - True once the AGENT TO FWD (AFT) pb of the CARGO SMOKE panel was pressed

A32NX_CARGOSMOKE_{FWD | AFT}_AGENT_RELEASED - Bool - True once the cargo fire bottles discharge into that compartment (the first AGENT pb pressed while a bottle is full; the AFT agent goes to the aft/bulk compartment). Drives the DISCH light of the AGENT pb

A32NX_CARGOSMOKE_BOTTLE_{1 | 2}_DISCHARGED - Bool - True when the cargo fire bottle is fully discharged: bottle 1 about one minute after the AGENT pb, then bottle 2 slowly, about four hours (A380 FCOM DSC-26-60-10 FIRE EXTINGUISHING). Drives the BTL 1(2) lights
A32NX_CARGOSMOKE_BOTTLE_{1 | 2}_LOW_PRESSURE - Bool - True when the cargo fire bottle lost its agent (flyPad failure "Cargo fire bottle 1(2) low pressure"); drives SMOKE FWD+AFT CARGO BTL 1(2) FAULT

A32NX_CARGOSMOKE_DIVERTER_VALVE_{FWD | AFT}_FAULT - Bool - True when the diverter valve of the cargo fire bottles cannot take its FWD (AFT) position (flyPad failure "Cargo fire bottles diverter valve FWD (AFT) position"): the AGENT TO FWD (AFT) pb then fires nothing. Drives SMOKE FWD (AFT) CARGO BOTTLES FAULT, or FWD+AFT CARGOS BOTTLES FAULT when both positions are failed

A32NX_CARGOSMOKE_BOTTLE_CONTROL_FAULT - Bool - True when the system that controls the cargo fire bottles is failed (flyPad failure "Cargo fire bottles control"): neither AGENT pb fires the bottles. Drives SMOKE FWD+AFT CARGOS BOTTLES FAULT

A32NX_SMOKE_AFT_LWR_CAB_REST_BTL_{1 | 2}_FAULT - Bool - True when fire extinguishing bottle 1(2) of the aft lower deck cabin crew rest is failed (flyPad failure "Aft lower deck cabin crew rest fire bottle 1(2)"); drives SMOKE AFT LWR CAB REST BTL 1(2) FAULT

A32NX_SMOKE_FACILITIES_DET_FAULT - Bool - True when the SDF does not detect the cabin configuration and the cabin smoke detectors (flyPad failure "Smoke detection facilities (cabin configuration) of the SDF"): the cabin areas then report neither smoke nor a detector fault. False while the SDF itself is failed. Drives SMOKE FACILITIES DET FAULT

A32NX_SMOKE_SAFETY_TEST_REQUIRED - Bool - True when the SDF missed its automatic safety tests (flyPad failure "SDF automatic safety test overdue"; the 50 h test history is not simulated). False while the SDF itself is failed. Drives SMOKE SAFETY TEST REQUIRED

The CG targeting of the automatic refuel then uses whichever of this entry and the FMS ZFW/ZFWCG changed last; with no entry it uses A32NX_AIRFRAME_ZFW_DESIRED / _CG_PERCENT_MAC_DESIRED

A380X_FMS_JETTISON_GW - Number in kilogram - The jettison gross weight (JTSN GW) entered on the FMS FUEL&LOAD page, 0 when none; the FQMS stops the jettison there - Written by the FMS
A380X_FUEL_JETTISON_IN_PROGRESS - Bool - The FQMS is jettisoning fuel (JETTISON ARM and ACTIVE pb-sw ON, and not completed)
A380X_FUEL_JETTISON_COMPLETED - Bool - The FQMS stopped the jettison (JTSN GW reached, or the transfer tanks empty), until both JETTISON pb-sw are OFF
A380X_FUEL_JETTISON_NOT_AVAIL - Bool - The jettison is selected (JETTISON ARM and ACTIVE pb-sw ON) but not available: both jettison valves failed closed
A380X_FUEL_JETTISON_{side}_VALVE_FAULT - Bool - {side} = L, R - The jettison valve is failed in the closed position, found when the jettison was selected, until it is repaired
A380X_FUEL_JETTISON_VALVE_NOT_CLOSED - Bool - A jettison valve is open while the jettison is not in progress (valve failed open)
A32NX_FQMS_GROSS_WEIGHT - Arinc429 - The total weight of the aircraft
A32NX_FQMS_CENTER_OF_GRAVITY_MAC - Arinc429 - The center of gravity of the aircraft

A32NX_FQMS_{tank}_TANK_QUANTITY - Arinc429 - The fuel quantity in a specific tank -{tank} - FEED_1 - FEED_2 - FEED_3 - FEED_4 - LEFT_OUTER - LEFT_MID - LEFT_INNER - RIGHT_OUTER - RIGHT_MID - RIGHT_INNER - TRIM
A32NX_FQMS_{side}_FUEL_PUMP_RUNNING_WORD - Arinc429 - Status word indicating different status - {side} - LEFT - RIGHT - | Bit | Meaning |

A32NX_FQDC_{id}_{tank}_TANK_QUANTITY - Arinc429 - The fuel quantity in a specific tank (AGP value) - {id} - 1 - 2 -{tank} - FEED_1 - FEED_2 - FEED_3 - FEED_4 - LEFT_OUTER - LEFT_MID - LEFT_INNER - RIGHT_OUTER - RIGHT_MID - RIGHT_INNER - TRIM

A32NX_FUEL_ENG_{number}_LP_VALVE_OPEN_PERCENTAGE - Percent - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - Position of the engine LP fuel valve, 0 when fully closed. The valve is closed by the ENG MASTER lever or the ENG FIRE pb (FCOM DSC-28-10 ENGINE LP VALVES) and travels in 3 s

A32NX_FUEL_ENG_{number}_FUEL_DOWNSTREAM_LP_VALVE - Number in kilogram - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - Fuel left between the engine LP fuel valve and the engine (1 gallon, the Extra tank of the fuel model). Full while the valve is open, burned at the engine fuel flow once the valve is fully closed

A32NX_FUEL_ENG_{number}_STARVED - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - True when the engine LP fuel valve is closed and the fuel downstream of it is burned: the FADEC shuts the engine down and it cannot relight. Cuts the engine fuel (A32NX_ENGINE_{number}_FUEL_CUT)

A32NX_FUEL_ENG_{number}_LP_VALVE_ABNORMALLY_OPEN - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - True when the engine LP fuel valve remains (partly) open while the ENG MASTER or the ENG FIRE pushbutton commands it closed, once its travel time plus 1 s is over: the valve is jammed (flyPad failure 28040-28043 "ENG n LP fuel valve jammed in place"). Written by the systems WASM (fuel/engine_lp_valve.rs)

A32NX_FUEL_ENG_{number}_LP_VALVE_ABNORMALLY_CLOSED - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - True when the engine LP fuel valve remains (partly) closed while it is commanded open, once its travel time plus 1 s is over (jammed valve). The engine is then starved (A32NX_FUEL_ENG_{number}_STARVED). Written by the systems WASM (fuel/engine_lp_valve.rs)

A380X_FUEL_LEAK_DETECTED - Bool - True when the FQMS fuel system leak detection has found a leak (FCOM DSC-28-40 FUEL LEAK DETECTION): the BLOCK fuel (FOB + fuel used when the four engines first run) exceeds the FOB + fuel used by more than 15 450 lb (slow leak), or the FOB decrease exceeds the fuel used by more than 4 400 lb within the last 30 min (fast leak). Stays until the end of the flight. Gives FUEL LEAK DETECTED. Written by systems-host CpiomF/FuelLeak

A380X_FUEL_LEAK_DET_FAULT - Bool - True while the FQMS fuel system leak detection is inhibited (an engine not running in flight, fuel jettison in progress): FUEL LEAK DET FAULT. The slow leak detection is then lost until the end of the flight. Written by systems-host CpiomF/FuelLeak

A380X_FUEL_FEED_TK_{number}_{pump}_PMP_LO_PR - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - {pump} - MAIN - STBY - True when the feed tank pump pb-sw is ON and the pump is not running (failed). Drives the pb-sw FAULT light, the amber pump of the SD FUEL page and the FUEL FEED TK {number} MAIN (STBY) PMP FAULT alerts (FCOM DSC-28-20, PRO-ABN-ECAM-10-28). Written by the systems host (CpiomF/FuelPumpsAndValves), which also simulates the ATA 28 feed pump failures by holding the MSFS pump switch (FUELSYSTEM PUMP SWITCH 1-8, ON in the flight files) off while the pb-sw keeps the pump circuit connected

A380X_FUEL_{pump}_PMP_FAULT - Bool - {pump} - L_OUTR_TK (MSFS pump 9) - R_OUTR_TK (pump 14) - L_MID_TK_FWD (pump 10) - R_MID_TK_FWD (pump 15) - L_INR_TK_FWD (pump 12) - R_INR_TK_FWD (pump 13) - TRIM_TK_L (pump 19) - TRIM_TK_R (pump 20) - True when the transfer pump pb-sw is ON and, for more than 2 s, the pump is failed (its failure 28030-28037 is active, whether or not the FQMS runs it at that time) or runs in an empty tank (below 0.1 gal): an empty tank alone gives no fault. Drives the pb-sw FAULT light, the amber pump of the SD FUEL page and the FUEL ... PMP FAULT alerts with the pb-sw OFF condition (FCOM DSC-28-20, PRO-ABN-ECAM-10-28). Written by the systems host (CpiomF/FuelPumpsAndValves), which also simulates the transfer pump failures by holding the MSFS pump switch off whatever the FQMS (the MSFS triggers of CpiomF/LegacyFuel) commands; while a pump is failed it follows the FQMS start/stop commands from the trigger changes (FUELSYSTEM TRIGGER STATUS), so that the repaired pump returns to what the FQMS wants

A380X_FUEL_CROSSFEED_VLV_{number}_ABNORMAL - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - True when the crossfeed valve position has disagreed with its CROSSFEED pb-sw for more than 5 s (abnormally closed or open): amber valve on the SD FUEL page and FUEL CROSSFEED VLV {number} FAULT. Written by the systems host (CpiomF/FuelPumpsAndValves)

A380X_OVHD_FUEL_CROSSFEED_{number}_PB_IS_ON - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - True when the CROSSFEED {number} pb-sw is ON (the flight crew selection, ON light and pb-sw animation). The systems host (CpiomF/FuelPumpsAndValves) commands the MSFS valve 46 (crossfeed 1) to 49 (crossfeed 4) (K:FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_OPEN/CLOSE) to follow it, except while the valve is jammed (failures 28020-28023), when the valve stays where it was. A valve switch change from outside (K:FUELSYSTEM_VALVE_* events, the refuel logic closing the valves) is taken as the new selection. The ECAM sensed CROSSFEED ... ON items read it (the crew action, done even if the valve is jammed closed); the green OPEN light of the pb-sw shows the valve fully open (FUELSYSTEM VALVE OPEN)

Closed for the ground test after 30 s, during the 10 min ground inhibition and during the takeoff until the takeoff thrust reduction

items: A32NX_MAN_PITOT_HEAT - Bool - The PROBE & WINDOW HEAT pb is ON: probes and windows heated before the engine start, and the backup heating of the probes whose automatic heating is lost
A32NX_PROBE_HEAT_ADR_{number}_AUTO_HEAT_FAULT - Bool - ADIRU {number} no longer commands the automatic heating of its probes: A-ICE ALL PROBES {number} NOT DEICED
A32NX_PROBE_HEAT_ADR_{number}_PROBES_HEATED - Bool - All probes of ADR {number} (pitot TAT AOA, left and right static, sideslip) are heated

A32NX_PROBE_HEAT_ADR_{number}_PITOT_TAT_AOA_FAULT / _STATIC_FAULT / _SIDESLIP_FAULT - Bool - The heater of the pitot TAT AOA probe, of a static probe or of the sideslip probe of ADR {number} is failed
A32NX_PROBE_HEAT_STBY_PITOT_FAULT / A32NX_PROBE_HEAT_STBY_STATIC_FAULT - Bool - The heater of the standby pitot probe or of the standby static probes is failed
A32NX_WINDOW_HEAT_{side}_{window}_FAULT - Bool - The heating of a cockpit window is failed, {side} L or R, {window} WINDSHIELD, SLIDING_WINDOW or FIXED_WINDOW
A32NX_ICE_DETECTOR_{number}_FAULT - Bool - Ice detector {number} (1 or 2) is failed or unpowered
A32NX_DRAIN_MAST_HEAT_FAULT - Bool - The drain mast heaters of the water/waste system are failed: CABIN DRAIN MASTS HEATING FAULT

A380X_OVHD_FUEL_{tank}_XFR_PB_IS_AUTO - Bool - {tank} - OUTRTK (OUTR TK XFR pb-sw) - MIDTK (MID TK XFR pb-sw) - INRTK (INR TK XFR pb-sw) - TRIMTK (TRIM TK XFR pb-sw) - True when the transfer pb-sw is in AUTO (released, no light); false in MAN (FWD for the trim tank: pressed in, MAN / FWD light). Set to true (AUTO) at every flight load by the systems host (CpiomF/LegacyFuel, FuelManualTransfer). While any of them is in MAN / FWD the automatic transfers stop and the systems host runs the manual transfers on the MSFS fuel system (FCOM DSC-28-40 MANUAL TRANSFERS): outer tank pumps via the forward gallery into the four feed tanks (with an outer tank pump pb-sw OFF, the emergency outer tank transfer valves open instead, by gravity into feed tanks 1 and 4), inner and mid tank aft pumps via the aft gallery into the feed tanks, trim tank pumps via the trim line isolation valve and the aft gallery into the inner tanks (into the feed tanks when an inner or mid tank manual transfer is also selected). Back to AUTO, the transfer pumps stop, the transfer valves close and the automatic transfers start again

A380X_OVHD_FUEL_AUTO_GND_XFR_PB_IS_ON - Bool - The AUTO GND XFR pb-sw is pressed: the FQMS runs the automatic ground transfer (CpiomF/FuelGroundTransfer, FCOM DSC-28-50-20): with all the transfer pump pb-sws ON, on ground, fewer than two engines running and the FQMS CG computed (ZFW / ZFCG entered in the FMS), the fuel moves out of (into) the trim tank into (out of) the inner tanks, then the mid tanks, until the GW CG reaches the ground CG target of 39.5 %, at 44 100 lb/h

A380X_OVHD_FUEL_AUTO_GND_XFR_PB_LIGHT_ON - Bool - The light of the AUTO GND XFR pb-sw: on while the pb-sw is pressed (in progress or completed), flashing when the FQMS aborted the ground transfer - Written by the systems host (CpiomF/FuelAutomaticTransfers)
A380X_FUEL_AUTO_GND_XFR_IN_PROGRESS - Bool - The automatic ground transfer is in progress (GND XFR IN PROGRESS memo)

A380X_FUEL_AUTO_GND_XFR_COMPLETED - Bool - The automatic ground transfer has completed (the CG reached 39.5 %, or no more fuel can move), until the AUTO GND XFR pb-sw is released (FUEL AUTO GND XFR COMPLETED)

A380X_FUEL_AUTO_GND_XFR_FAULT - Bool - The automatic ground transfer could not start (a transfer pump pb-sw OFF, no FQMS CG, in flight, a refuel, jettison or manual transfer in progress) or was aborted (two engines running), until the AUTO GND XFR pb-sw is released (FUEL AUTO GND XFR FAULT)

A380X_OVHD_FUEL_TRIM_TK_FEED_SELECTOR - Number - The TRIM TK FEED selector: 0 AUTO (the value at flight load), 1 OPEN, 2 ISOL. The cockpit model has no such selector: the L:var is set from outside the cockpit (e.g. the developer mode). ISOL stops the transfers out of the trim tank (main and CG transfers of CpiomF/LegacyFuel, load alleviation, TRIM TK XFR FWD): trim tank pumps stopped, trim line valves closed. OPEN lets the trim tank fuel flow by gravity into the inner tanks (1 000 gal/h, pitch attitude below 3°)
A380X_FUEL_TRIM_TK_GRAVITY_XFR_IN_PROGRESS - Bool - The trim tank fuel flows by gravity into the inner tanks (TRIM TK FEED OPEN)

A380X_FUEL_LOAD_ALLEVIATION_XFR_{transfer} - Bool - {transfer} - TO_OUTR_TKS: in flight, FOB above 110 200 lb, the outer tanks not full: inner (then mid) tanks to the outer tanks, 44 100 lb/h per outer tank - FROM_TRIM_TK: before landing (remaining time to destination below 80 min for 3 min, or below FL 245 after FL 255; stops above 80 min, resumes below 78 min): trim tank to the feed (then mid, then inner) tanks, 44 100 lb/h - FROM_OUTR_TKS: before landing (the same with 30 and 28 min): outer tanks above 8 800 lb to the feed (then mid, then inner) tanks of their side, 33 050 lb/h per outer tank - The load alleviation transfer is in progress (CpiomF/FuelLoadAlleviation, FCOM DSC-28-30). The remaining time to destination is read from A32NX_FM{number}_REMAINING_FLIGHT_TIME; below 90 min the main transfer thresholds of the feed tanks are also reduced (36 500 lb / 39 350 lb instead of 43 100 lb / 45 950 lb)

A380X_FUEL_ALTN_OUTR_TK_GRAVITY_XFR_IN_PROGRESS - Bool - The alternate gravity transfer from an outer tank with a failed pump runs (FCOM DSC-28-40 CASE 5: from the lowest feed tank below 28 660 lb, into FEED TK 2 (3), 500 gal/h); the FWS raises FUEL NORM XFR FAULT from it

A32NX_FUEL_QUANTITY_SYSTEM_FAULTS - Number (bit field), written by the Rust fuel system whatever the power of the FQMS - The faults of the fuel quantity measurement: bit 0-1 FQMS 1-2 (failed, or a CPIOM-F of its pair not available: FQMS 1 on CPIOM-F1 and F3, FQMS 2 on F2 and F4), bit 2-3 FQDC 1-2 (failed or unpowered), bit 4-5 the Alternate Gauging Processor of FQDC 1-2 (failed, or its FQDC failed) - Both FQMS failed: the A32NX_FQMS_* words are failure warning, the FUEL SD page shows the FQDC (alternate gauging) quantities with their last two digits dashed

A32NX_FUEL_FQI_LOST_TANKS - Number (bit field): bit n for the tank n of LEFT_OUTER, FEED_1, LEFT_MID, LEFT_INNER, FEED_2, FEED_3, RIGHT_INNER, RIGHT_MID, FEED_4, RIGHT_OUTER, TRIM - The quantity indication probes of the tank are lost (flyPad failure): its A32NX_FQDC_{id}_{tank}_TANK_QUANTITY words are no computed data

A32NX_FUEL_GAUGING_DEGRADED_TANKS - Number (bit field), the tanks as A32NX_FUEL_FQI_LOST_TANKS - The gauging accuracy of the tank is degraded (flyPad failure): the FUEL SD page shows its quantity with the last two digits dashed (FUEL GAUGING FAULT)

A380X_FUEL_XFR_MAN_ONLY - Bool, written by the systems host (CpiomF/FuelTransferFaults) - The FQMS no longer makes automatic transfers and the flight crew transfers manually (FUEL MAN XFR PROCEDURE): both FQMS, both FQDCs or both AGPs failed, the quantity of a feed tank lost, or a wing tank overflow while no manual transfer was selected. Once set in flight it stays for the rest of the flight; on ground it follows the failures

A380X_FUEL_{tank}_TANK_TEMPERATURE - Number in degrees Celsius - {tank}: LEFT_OUTER, FEED_1, LEFT_MID, LEFT_INNER, FEED_2, FEED_3, RIGHT_INNER, RIGHT_MID, FEED_4, RIGHT_OUTER, TRIM - The fuel temperature of the tank (CpiomF/FuelTankTemperatures): a first order lag towards the outside air temperature on ground and the total air temperature in flight, faster for the thin outer and trim tanks and for tanks with less fuel. Shown on the FUEL SD page (outer and trim tanks while their sensor is immersed, feed tanks when abnormal or with MORE); FUEL TEMP LO below -40 °C, FUEL FEED TK 1(2)(3)(4) TEMP HI above 53 °C - Written by the systems host

A380X_FUEL_COLLECTOR_CELL_{number}_QUANTITY - Number in kilograms - {number}: 1 to 4, the collector cell of the feed tank - The fuel in the collector cell (CpiomF/FuelCollectorCells): full (2 866 lb, never more than the feed tank) while a feed tank pump runs or the engine is off; emptied by the engine when it is fed by gravity. FUEL COLLECTOR CELL 1(2)(3)(4) NOT FULL below 1 735 lb, until above 2 076 lb - Written by the systems host

A380X_WBBC_GROSS_WEIGHT - Arinc429 - The gross weight of the Weight and Balance Backup Computer (CpiomF/WeightBalanceBackup): from the first slats and flaps retraction in flight, the simulator's aerodynamic weight, after a slats/flaps extension the takeoff GW minus the fuel used; no computed data on ground and before the retraction. The FWS compares it with the FQMS GW (FUEL WEIGHT DATA DISAGREE above 198 400 lb). Failure warning while both WBBCs are failed (flyPad failures WBBC 1 and 2): FUEL WEIGHT & BALANCE BKUP FAULT

A380X_WBBC_CENTER_OF_GRAVITY_MAC - Arinc429 - The WBBC CG: the simulator's CG (A32NX_AIRFRAME_GW_CG_PERCENT_MAC) while the slats and flaps are retracted in flight, no computed data otherwise. FUEL EXCESS AFT CG above 50 % in automatic transfer mode, FUEL CG DATA DISAGREE above 8 % from the FQMS CG; the FMS uses it when the FQMS CG is not available

A380X_FUEL_APU_FEED_ABNORMALLY_CLOSED - Bool - True when the APU LP valve or the APU isolation valve stays closed for 5 s while both are commanded open (APU MASTER pb-sw ON, APU FIRE pb in): a jammed valve (flyPad failure). Gives FUEL APU FEED FAULT; the APU gets no fuel (systems a380 fuel/apu_feed.rs). Written by systems-host CpiomF/FuelApuFeed, which opens and closes the MSFS valves 50 and 51

A380X_FUEL_APU_FEED_ABNORMALLY_OPEN - Bool - True when an APU feed valve stays open for 5 s while both are commanded closed (APU MASTER pb-sw OFF or APU FIRE pb pushed): FUEL APU FEED VLV NOT CLOSED. Written by systems-host CpiomF/FuelApuFeed

A380X_FUEL_{side}_WING_TK_OVERFLOW / A380X_FUEL_TRIM_TK_OVERFLOW - Bool - {side}: L, R - True when the surge tank holds more than 1 730 lb (wing) or 524 lb (trim): FUEL WING TK OVERFLOW, FUEL TRIM TK OVERFLOW. The FQMS then stops the refuel and the automatic ground transfer. Written by systems-host CpiomF/FuelOverflow

A380X_FUEL_{tank}_SURGE_TK_FUEL_LB - Number (pounds) - {tank}: L, R, TRIM - The fuel in the surge tank: with the inlet valve of the outer (trim) tank stuck open (flyPad failure), fuel pushed by a refuel or by the transfer pumps of other tanks spills from the full tank at 44 100 lb/h (taken from the pumped tanks), and drains back at 4 400 lb/h once the tank has room. Written by systems-host CpiomF/FuelOverflow

A380X_FUEL_REFUEL_FAULT - Bool - True while the refuel system is failed (flyPad failure: any refuel stops at once) or after an overflow stopped a refuel, until the overflow is gone: FUEL REFUEL FAULT. Written by systems-host CpiomF/FuelRefuelFaults

A380X_FUEL_REFUEL_{side}_ISOL_VALVE_FAULT - Bool - {side}: L, R - True while the refuel isolation valve is failed (flyPad failure, no effect on the refuel): FUEL REFUEL / DEFUEL SYS FAULT. Written by systems-host CpiomF/FuelRefuelFaults

A32NX_FQMS_PREDICTED_GROSS_WEIGHT - Arinc429 - The gross weight at the end of the refuel: the refuel ZFW (A32NX_AIRFRAME_ZFW_DESIRED) plus the preselected fuel (A32NX_FUEL_DESIRED). No computed data while the FQMS does not compute. Written by the systems WASM (fuel/cpiom_f/refuel_prediction.rs)

A32NX_FQMS_PREDICTED_CENTER_OF_GRAVITY_MAC - Arinc429 - The gross weight CG at the end of the refuel: the preselected fuel distributed as the automatic refuel does, with the refuel ZFW and ZFCG. FUEL PREDICTED CG OUT OF T.O RANGE when outside the takeoff CG limits during a refuel. Written by the systems WASM

A32NX_FQMS_REFUEL_DISTRIBUTION_DEVIATION - Arinc429 - The largest difference between a tank quantity and the standard distribution of the fuel on board. FUEL ABNORM AUTO REFUEL DISTRIBUTION above 900 lb after a refuel. Written by the systems WASM

A32NX_FM{number}_REMAINING_FLIGHT_TIME - Arinc429 - {number} 1 or 2 - The predicted time to the destination, no computed data without a prediction - Written by the FMS, read by the FQMS (CpiomF/LegacyFuel, FuelAutomaticTransfers)
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_1_1_AVAIL - Bool - Indicates if the first CAN bus of the CDS on the captain's side is available
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_1_2_AVAIL - Bool - Indicates if the first CAN bus of the CDS on the captain's side is available
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_2_1_AVAIL - Bool - Indicates if the first CAN bus of the CDS on the first officer's side is available
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_2_2_AVAIL - Bool - Indicates if the first CAN bus of the CDS on the first officer's side is available
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_1_1_FAILURE - Bool - Indicates if the first CAN bus of the CDS on the captain's side simulates a failure
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_1_2_FAILURE - Bool - Indicates if the first CAN bus of the CDS on the captain's side simulates a failure
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_2_1_FAILURE - Bool - Indicates if the first CAN bus of the CDS on the first officer's side simulates a failure
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_2_2_FAILURE - Bool - Indicates if the first CAN bus of the CDS on the first officer's side simulates a failure
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_1_1__RECEIVED - Bool - Indicates if the system per function ID in the CDS bus received the last sent message
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_1_1 - ArincWord852‹> - First CAN bus of the CDS on the captain's side
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_1_2 - ArincWord852‹> - Second CAN bus of the CDS on the captain's side
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_2_1 - ArincWord852‹> - First CAN bus of the CDS on the first officer's side
A32NX_CDS_CAN_BUS_2_2 - ArincWord852‹> - Second CAN bus of the CDS on the first officer's side

A380X_CDS_{DU}_DU_FAILED - Bool - The display unit is failed (flyPad failure, ATA 31): it is blank. Written by the DU's instrument (CdsDisplayUnit); the legacy SD reads the SD one, the ND weather radar / terrain gauge (ndwxr) the ND ones. - {DU} - CAPT_PFD - CAPT_ND - CAPT_MFD - EWD - SD - FO_MFD - FO_ND - FO_PFD

A380X_CDS_{DU}_DU_DISPLAY - Number - The display the display unit shows after the CDS reconfiguration (A380 FCOM DSC-31-15-20). Written by the systems host (Misc/CdsReconfiguration.ts); read by the display gauges of the DU (the DU's own gauge hides, a hosted gauge of another display starts and runs only while shown) and, for the ND DUs, by the ND weather radar / terrain gauge (ndwxr), which draws nothing while the ND DU shows another display. Stays 0 in normal operation. - 0: its own display - 1: PFD (on the ND DU: PFD DU lost, or PFD/ND pb) - 2: ND (on the PFD DU: PFD/ND pb, or DU RECONF pb) - 3: MFD (not drawn on another DU) - 4: EWD (on the SD DU: EWD DU lost; on the ND DU: DU RECONF pb) - 5: SD (on the ND DU: DU RECONF pb; with the ATC mailbox, see A380X_CDS_MAILBOX_DU) - {DU} - CAPT_PFD - CAPT_ND - CAPT_MFD - EWD - SD - FO_MFD - FO_ND - FO_PFD - A display unit is lost when it is failed (flyPad ATA 31), unpowered, or switched off with its brightness knob. The PFD/ND pbs send `H:A380X_EFIS_L_PFD_ND_PUSHED` / `H:A380X_EFIS_R_PFD_ND_PUSHED` and the DU RECONF pbs `H:A380X_EFIS_L_DU_RECONF_PUSHED` / `H:A380X_EFIS_R_DU_RECONF_PUSHED` (cockpit behaviour); the systems host keeps their state.

A380X_CDS_MAILBOX_DU - Number - The display unit whose ATC mailbox (the bottom section of the SD) is the active mailbox client, the only one that answers the flight crew and publishes to the ATC function (A380 FCOM PRO-ABN-ECAM-10-31: "If the SD DU is turned OFF, use the F/O DU RECONF P/B for ATC mailbox"). Written by the systems host (Misc/CdsReconfiguration.ts); read by every SDv2 gauge (the SD DU's own and the SD drawn on the ND DUs). The SD DU wins while it is operative and shows the SD; else the ND DU that shows the SD; else none (no mailbox marks a new message as displayed or read). - 0: the SD DU (normal operation, also before the systems host writes it) - 1: the CAPT ND DU - 4: the F/O ND DU - -1: none (the SD is shown on no operative display unit)

A32NX_FWS_AUDIO_{voice} - Bool - True while the FWS says this synthetic voice, played from a WAV clip (sound/fws_.wav, tools/fws-voice) - {voice} - PRIORITY_LEFT: the CAPT holds the sidestick pb (CpiomC/FlightWarningSystem/FwsSidestickPriority.ts) - PRIORITY_RIGHT: the F/O holds the sidestick pb - WINDSHEAR: WINDSHEAR said three times, at the reactive windshear warning (FlightWarningSystem/FwsWindshearAural.ts) - PITCH: PITCH PITCH, at the pitch attitude alert of a manual landing (FlightWarningSystem/FwsPitchAural.ts) - COMPANY_MESSAGE: COMPANY MESSAGE, when a company message is received (FlightWarningSystem/FwsCompanyMessageAural.ts) - HEIGHT_{feet}: one word of the intermediate radio height callout below 100 ft (shared/src/AutoCallOuts.ts): {feet} 1 to 9 (but 5) and 11 to 19, e.g. HEIGHT_7 for the SEVEN of FORTY SEVEN

A32NX_BTN_{button_name} - Number - Button state of the ECAM CP buttons - 0: Not pressed, 1: Pressed - {button_name} - ALL - ABNPROC - CHECK_LH - CHECK_RH - CL - CLR - CLR2 - DOWN - EMERCANC - MORE - RCL - RCL_LAST - TOCONFIG - UP
A32NX_ECAM_SD_CURRENT_PAGE_INDEX - Enum
Currently requested page on the ECAM CP - | State | Value |

A380X_ECAM_SD_ADVISORY_PB - Number - Read only! - The ECAM CP page pb lit by an ECAM advisory (steady, or flashing while the crew has another page selected): the page index of A32NX_ECAM_SD_CURRENT_PAGE_INDEX + 1, 0 when none (A380 FCOM DSC-31-40-10 ADVISORY)

A32NX_FCU_SWITCHED_OFF - Boolean - The FCU is switched off (A380 FCOM DSC-22-FG-80-40: the left FCU brightness knob turned to its end): the FCU model shuts the EFIS CPs and the AFS CP down and the FWS raises CDS & AUTO FLT FCU SWITCHED OFF - No cockpit control writes it yet
A380X_EFIS_{side}_LS_BUTTON_IS_ON - Boolean - Whether the LS button is activated - {side} = L or R
A380X_EFIS_{side}_VV_BUTTON_IS_ON - Boolean - Whether the VV button is activated - {side} = L or R
A380X_EFIS_{side}_CSTR_BUTTON_IS_ON - Boolean - Whether the CSTR button is activated - {side} = L or R
A380X_EFIS_{side}_ACTIVE_FILTER - Boolean - Indicates which waypoint filter is selected - {side} = L or R - | State | Value |
A380X_EFIS_{side}_ACTIVE_OVERLAY - Boolean - Indicates which waypoint filter is selected - {side} = L or R - | State | Value |
A380X_EFIS_{side}_ARPT_BUTTON_IS_ON - Boolean - Whether the ARPT button is activated - {side} = L or R

A380X_EFIS_{side}_TRAF_BUTTON_IS_ON - Boolean - Whether the TRAF button is activated - {side} = L or R - Not written by any system; the TRAF pb state is A32NX_FCU_EFIS_{side}_TRAF_LIGHT_ON (FCU), read by the TCAS, which also pushes the TRAF pbs on (A32NX.FCU_EFIS_{side}_TRAF_PUSH) when a TA or RA starts
A380X_EFIS_{side}_BARO_PRESELECTED - Number (hPa or inHg) - Pre-selected QNH when in STD mode, or 0 when not displayed. - Not for FBW systems use! - {side} = L or R

A32NX_KCCU_{side}_KBD_ON_OFF - Bool - The keyboard ON/OFF switch of the KCCU: the keyboard keys (and the MFD entry by KCCU) work only when ON (A380 FCOM DSC-31-30-20) - ON by default: set ON in every flight start (cold and dark included) and by the Powered aircraft preset - {side} = L or R

A32NX_KCCU_{side}_CCD_ON_OFF - Bool - The cursor control device ON/OFF switch of the KCCU: its ESC, KBD and navigation keys work only when ON - ON by default: set ON in every flight start (cold and dark included) and by the Powered aircraft preset - {side} = L or R - A failed keyboard or cursor control device (flyPad failures CAPT/F/O KCCU keyboard, cursor control device or whole KCCU, ATA 31) takes no key press either, as when OFF

A32NX_BRAKES_{mode}_BRK_FAULT - Bool - True when the braking mode is failed on all the wheel groups (flyPad failures 32110-32112, Rust `hydraulic/brake_steer_faults.rs`); read by the FWS for the BRAKES alerts - {mode} - NORM: BCS normal braking (BRAKES NORM BRK FAULT) - ALTN: BCS alternate braking (BRAKES ALTN BRK FAULT) - EMER: EBCU emergency braking (BRAKES EMER BRK FAULT)
A32NX_BRAKES_PEDAL_BRAKING_MODE - Number - The braking mode the brake pedals command - | Mode | Value |

A32NX_BRAKES_CTL_{number}_FAULT - Bool - True when braking control system {number} (1 or 2) is failed (flyPad failures 32120-32121, Rust `hydraulic/brake_anti_skid_faults.rs`): BRAKES CTL 1(2) FAULT. Both failed: emergency braking

A32NX_BRAKES_RDC_CHANNEL_FAULTS - Number (bit field) - The failed channels of the remote data concentrators that carry the anti-skid of one main gear group (flyPad failures 32122-32127): bit 0 RDC 1 (wing gears) channel A, bit 1 RDC 1 channel B, bit 2 RDC 2 (right body gear) channel A, bit 3 RDC 2 channel B, bit 4 RDC 3 (left body gear) channel A, bit 5 RDC 3 channel B. Both channels of an RDC failed: that gear group brakes without anti-skid (EBCU pressure law)

A32NX_BRAKES_RELEASED_PAIRS - Number (bit field) - Bit n set when brake pair n (bit 0 brakes 1/2 ... bit 7 brakes 15/16) is released in normal or alternate braking because of its failed wheel tachometer (flyPad failures 32160-32167): BRAKES RELEASED
A32NX_BRAKES_RESIDUAL_PAIRS - Number (bit field) - Bit n set when brake pair n keeps a residual pressure from its leaking normal servo valve (flyPad failures 32170-32177): BRAKES RESIDUAL BRAKING
A32NX_BRAKES_AUTO_BRK_FAULT - Bool - True when the autobrake is failed (flyPad failure 32113, Rust `hydraulic/autobrakes.rs`): the autobrake cannot be armed; read by the FWS for BRAKES AUTO BRK FAULT

A32NX_STEERING_{fault}_FAULT - Bool - True when the steering equipment is failed (flyPad failures 32200-32204, Rust `hydraulic/brake_steer_faults.rs`); read by the FWS for the STEER alerts - {fault} - NORM_NWS: normal nose wheel steering (GREEN) - ALTN_NWS: alternate nose wheel steering (steering LEHGS) - BWS: body wheel steering, centred and locked - SCS_1, SCS_2: steering control system 1 or 2
A32NX_STEERING_NWS_MODE - Number - The hydraulic supply of the nose wheel steering - | Mode | Value |

head: Off (engines shut down or NWS failed)

items: A32NX_STEERING_BWS_NOT_LOCKED - Bool - True when a body wheel steering locking mechanism is failed (flyPad failures 32210-32211, Rust `hydraulic/brake_steer_faults.rs`): that axle is not centred and locked and the gear does not retract; read by the FWS for STEER B/W STEER NOT LOCKED
A32NX_STEERING_PEDAL_CTL_FAULT - Bool - True when the SCS no longer receives the rudder pedal orders (flyPad failure 32212): only the tillers steer; read by the FWS for STEER PEDAL STEER CTL FAULT
A32NX_STEERING_NWS_ANGLE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED - Bool - True while the nose wheel steering angle is beyond 73.5 degrees (a tight tow turn); read by the FWS for STEER N/W STEER ANGLE LIMIT EXCEEDED

A32NX_LG_{fault}_FAULT - Bool - Landing gear faults of the LGCIS (Rust `hydraulic/gear_steering_monitoring.rs`); read by the FWS for the L/G alerts - {fault} - UPLOCK: an uplock closed behind its extended gear (flyPad failures 32030-32032) - BOGIE_POSITION: a bogie out of its pitch attitude with the gear down (flyPad failure 32033) - GRVTY_EXTN: the gravity extension system (LGERS) failed its test, the L/G GRVTY sw releases no uplock (flyPad failure 32034) - RETRACTION: the gear lever was set UP out of the retraction configuration (L/G RETRACTION FAULT); stays until the gears are locked up or the aircraft is on ground

A32NX_LG_RETRACTION_INHIBITED - Bool - True while the LGCIS keep the gears down: the lever is UP with a gear out of its retraction configuration (shock absorber not extended, nose wheel not centred, body wheel steering not locked, bogie or uplock fault). The LGCIUs then take the lever as DOWN; a lever recycle is a new retraction attempt
A32NX_BTV_STATE - Boolean - Indicates the current state of the BTV system - | State | Value |

A32NX_FWC_1_BTV_INOP - Bool - Written by the FWS: an active ECAM alert lists BTV in STATUS INOP SYS (ENG 2(3) SHUT DOWN, TWO ENGS OUT, ENG 2(3) REVERSER failures). Like A32NX_BTV_LOST, BTV then does not arm and an armed BTV reverts to BRK HI

A380X_TPIS_TIRE_{n}_PRESSURE - Number (PSI) - The TPIS pressure of tire n, 0 to 400 PSI by 5 PSI steps (systems-host `Misc/Tpis.ts`): 220 (the normal 217.5 PSI) unless the tire deflation failure (flyPad failures 32300-32321) is active; read by the SD WHEEL page - {n} - 1 to 20: the main gear tires, numbered as on the SD WHEEL page (wing gears 1-8, body gears 9-20) - 21: left nose tire, 22: right nose tire
`L:A380X_PED_LIGHTING_MIP_FLOOD_LT_KNOB` - Number - Position of the main panel flood light knob (0-100)
`L:A380X_PED_LIGHTING_AMBIENT_LT_KNOB` - Number - Position of the ambient light knob (0-100)
`L:A380X_PED_LIGHTING_MIP_FLOOD_LT_LEVEL` - Number - Brightness of the main panel flood lights (0-100)
`L:A380X_PED_LIGHTING_AMBIENT_LT_LEVEL` - Number - Brightness of the ambient lights (0-100)

`L:A32NX_NO_SMOKING_MEMO` - Bool - True when the cabin NO SMOKING signs are on: NO SMOKING sw ON; at AUTO with the slats or the main landing gear extended; or with an excessive cabin altitude, regardless of the switch (systems host Misc/CabinSigns.ts)
`L:A380X_WXR_OFF` - Bool - Set from the WXR button of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page. True when the weather radar is switched OFF (false = AUTO)
`L:A380X_WXR_PRED_WS_OFF` - Bool - Set from the PRED W/S button of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page. True when the predictive windshear is switched OFF (false = AUTO) - Not used by any system yet
`L:A380X_WXR_TURB_OFF` - Bool - Set from the TURB button of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page. True when the turbulence detection is switched OFF (false = AUTO)

`L:A380X_WXR_GAIN_MAN` - Bool - Set from the GAIN button of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page and the SURV panel GAIN knob (pull MAN, push AUTO; H events A380X_WXR_GAIN_KNOB_PUSH/_PULL/_INC/_DEC of the cockpit, systems host Misc/WxrSurvKnobs.ts). True when the gain is MANUAL (false = AUTO) - Shown in the WXR messages of the ND (GAIN, ELEVN, TILT); read by the native radar (ndwxr): MANUAL applies L:A380X_WXR_GAIN, AUTO the calibrated gain

`L:A380X_WXR_GAIN` - Number (percent) - Set from the GAIN entry field of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page (shown with GAIN MAN), and turned with the SURV panel GAIN knob (1 % per detent, 50 % when nothing is entered), 0 to 100, -9999 when nothing is entered - Shown in the WXR messages of the ND (GAIN, ELEVN, TILT); read by the native radar (ndwxr) with GAIN MAN: 50 % (and no entry) = calibrated, 0 % = -16 dB, 100 % = +10 dB, the rain rate each colour starts at moves with it (turbulence unchanged)

`L:A380X_WXR_ELEVN_TILT_MODE` - Enum - Set from the ELEVN/TILT option list of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page and the SURV panel ELEVN knob (push AUTO, pull ELEVN, pull again TILT; H events A380X_WXR_ELEVN_KNOB_PUSH/_PULL/_INC/_DEC, systems host Misc/WxrSurvKnobs.ts) - Shown in the WXR messages of the ND (GAIN, ELEVN, TILT); read by the native radar (ndwxr): in ELEVN or TILT the ND hides the weather where the selected altitude or tilt reaches the ground - | State | Number |

`L:A380X_WXR_ELEVN` - Number (feet) - Set from the ELEVN entry field of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page and turned with the SURV panel ELEVN knob in ELEVN mode (100 ft per detent), 0 to 60000 (FL 0 to FL 600 with the STD reference), -9999 when nothing is entered - Shown in the WXR messages of the ND (GAIN, ELEVN, TILT); read by the native radar (ndwxr): at or below the ground under the aircraft the ND shows no weather

`L:A380X_WXR_TILT` - Number (degrees) - Set from the TILT entry field of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page and turned with the SURV panel ELEVN knob in TILT mode (0.1 degree per detent), -15.0 to +15.0, -9999 when nothing is entered - Shown in the WXR messages of the ND (GAIN, ELEVN, TILT); read by the native radar (ndwxr): a down tilt shows the weather only up to the range where the tilted surface reaches the ground
`L:A380X_WXR_MODE_MAP` - Bool - Set from the MODE button of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page. True when the radar mode is MAP (false = WX)
`L:A380X_WXR_VD_OFF` - Bool - Set from the WX ON VD button of the MFD SURV CONTROLS page. True when the weather on the VD is switched OFF (false = AUTO)

`L:A32NX_TAWS_SYS_IN_USE` - Number - The SURV system that provides the TAWS functions (1 or 2, 0 = no WXR/TAWS system selected), written by the systems host (EfisTawsBridge) - Normally the selected WXR/TAWS system (`L:A32NX_WXR_TAWS_SYS_SELECTED`); the other system after the automatic reconfiguration of SURV TAWS 1(2) FAULT (the TAWS of the selected system failed, the WXR of the other system failed, its TAWS operative), shown as TAWS 1(2) IN USE on the MFD SURV STATUS & SWITCHING page - Read by the GPWS, the FWS (TERR STBY), the MFD SURV pages and the ND/VD terrain (ndwxr)

`L:A32NX_WXR_{1,2}_TURB_FAILED` - Bool - The turbulence detection of SURV SYS 1 (2) is failed: its flyPad failure, or the system lost (SURV SYS failure, AESU reset) or unpowered. Written by the systems host (EfisTawsBridge) - Read by the FWS (SURV TURB 1(2)(1+2) FAULT), the MFD SURV STATUS & SWITCHING page and the ND radar (ndwxr: no magenta turbulence from a failed system)

`L:A32NX_WXR_{1,2}_PRED_WS_FAILED` - Bool - The predictive windshear function of SURV SYS 1 (2) is failed, as `L:A32NX_WXR_{1,2}_TURB_FAILED`. Written by the systems host (EfisTawsBridge) - Read by the FWS (SURV PRED W/S 1(2)(1+2) FAULT) and the MFD SURV STATUS & SWITCHING page
`L:A380X_TCAS_ALERT_LEVEL` - Enum - The TCAS alert level selected on the MFD SURV CONTROLS page, mirrored by the TCAS computer for the pedestal SURV panel lights - | State | Number |
`L:A380X_TCAS_ALT_SELECT` - Enum - The TCAS altitude range selected on the MFD SURV CONTROLS page, mirrored by the TCAS computer for the pedestal SURV panel lights - | State | Number |

`L:A380X_TCAS_ALERT_LEVEL_REQUEST` - Number - Written by the TCAS buttons of the pedestal SURV panel, read and reset to 0 by the TCAS computer - 0 = no request, otherwise the wanted `L:A380X_TCAS_ALERT_LEVEL` plus one

`L:A380X_TCAS_ALT_SELECT_REQUEST` - Number - Written by the ABV / BLW buttons of the pedestal SURV panel, read and reset to 0 by the TCAS computer - 0 = no request, otherwise the wanted `L:A380X_TCAS_ALT_SELECT` plus one

A32NX_WXR_ND_{side}_MODE - Enum - The weather radar mode text shown on the ND, published by the ndwxr gauge only while the radar is selected on a map page (ROSE ILS / VOR / NAV or ARC), 0 otherwise. Shared with the A32NX. The A380X has no TURB-only mode. - {side} = L or R - | State | Number |

A380X_VD_CUT_MODE - Enum - The vertical cut of the VD's terrain profile drawn by the ndwxr gauge, published by EfisTawsBridge (FCOM DSC-31-20-40-10): 0 = along the aircraft's track (selected lateral modes, or no usable flight plan), 1 = along the active flight plan (the vertices below)
A380X_VD_CUT_COUNT - Number - Number of vertices of the flight plan cut (2 to 32), 0 when the cut is along the track

A380X_VD_CUT_{index}_LAT / A380X_VD_CUT_{index}_LON - Degrees - Vertex {index} (0 to 31) of the flight plan cut: the start of every path vector, the midpoint of every turn, the end of the last vector and a straight extension of 160 NM beyond it, from the vertex before the one closest to the aircraft over the next 200 NM
A380X_VD_CUT_TRACK_CHANGE_NM - Number (NM) - Distance along the cut at which the next track change is more than 3 degrees (the grey area of the VD), -1 when none

A380X_VD_AIRPORT_COUNT - Number - Number of airports (0 to 24) the ndwxr gauge draws as flat ground on the VD, published by EfisTawsBridge: the airports within 25 NM of the aircraft, closest first (the terrain MapView draws the airport diagram over the terrain, which the VD would otherwise read as high terrain)
A380X_VD_AIRPORT_{index}_LAT / A380X_VD_AIRPORT_{index}_LON - Degrees - The centre of the circle of airport {index} (0 to 23): the smallest circle holding the corners of all its runways
A380X_VD_AIRPORT_{index}_RADIUS_NM - Number (NM) - The radius of that circle plus 0.3 NM for the taxiways and aprons beside and beyond the outer runways
A380X_VD_AIRPORT_{index}_ELEVATION_FT - Number (feet) - The highest runway threshold of airport {index}: the elevation of its flat ground on the VD

A380X_VD_{side}_RA_ZONE_SHOWN - Bool - The VD of side {side} (1 = captain, 2 = first officer) shows the amber radio altitude zone under the aircraft symbol (below 5 000 ft RA, FCOM DSC-31-20-40-10), written by VerticalDisplay.tsx: the ndwxr gauge then leaves the plot column under the zone clear of its terrain and weather picture

`L:A32NX_EGPWC_ND_{L,R}_TERRAIN_{MIN,MAX}_ELEVATION` and `..._ELEVATION_MODE` - The TERR ON ND peaks box figures, written by the ndwxr gauge; same variables and values as on the A32NX, see the GPWS / TAWS section of fbw-a32nx/docs/a320-simvars.md

`L:A32NX_TRANSPONDER_SYSTEM` - Number - The XPDR & TCAS system in use, set on the SURV panel and the MFD SURV STATUS & SWITCHING page: 0 = SYS 1, 1 = SYS 2 - MSFS has one transponder: it is driven as the transponder of the selected system (XPDR 1: failure 34003, AC ESS; XPDR 2: failure 34004, AC 4)

`L:A32NX_XPDR_{1,2}_FAILED` - Bool - True when the transponder of SURV SYS 1/2 is failed (failure 34003/34004) or unpowered (SYS 1: AC ESS, SYS 2: AC 4), whether it is selected or not. Shown on the MFD SURV STATUS & SWITCHING page

`L:A32NX_TCAS_{1,2}_FAILED` - Bool - True when the TCAS of SURV SYS 1/2 is inoperative: its XPDR is failed or unpowered (`L:A32NX_XPDR_{1,2}_FAILED`), or the system is selected and the TCAS computer reports a fault (`L:A32NX_TCAS_FAULT`, the single sim TCAS is the TCAS of the selected system). Shown on the MFD SURV STATUS & SWITCHING page
A32NX_FMGC_{side}_GPS_PRIMARY - Bool - The FMS navigation is in GPS PRIMARY. Written by the FMS (fmgc navigation/Navigation.ts), read by the PFD for the FLS approach capability - {side} - L - R

A32NX_FM_GPS_POS_DISAGREE - Bool - The FMS FM/GPS position disagree condition for the NAV FM / GPS POS DISAGREE alert: an FMS position more than the FCOM latitude/longitude thresholds away from a GPS receiver position (FCOM PRO-ABN-ECAM-10-34-10). Written by the FMS (fmgc navigation/FmPosition.ts), read by the FWS

A32NX_FM_IR_POS_DISAGREE - Bool - The FMS FM/IR position disagree condition for the NAV FM / IR POS DISAGREE alert: an FMS position more than 5 NM from a valid IR position, not in GPS PRIMARY. Written by the FMS (fmgc navigation/FmPosition.ts), read by the FWS

A32NX_PRIM_ADR_{number}_REJECTED - Bool - number: 1, 2 or 3 - ADR {number} is rejected by the PRIM air data monitoring: its CAS, Mach or pressure altitude diverges from the other coherent air data sources (A380 FCOM DSC-34-10-30-10). Latched until the end of the flight (on ground below 30 kt). Written by systems.wasm (`a380_systems` air_data_monitoring.rs); fbw.wasm then sends this ADR to the PRIM and SEC models with a failure warning status (two rejected ADRs: alternate law, three: direct law)
A32NX_PRIM_STBY_AIR_DATA_REJECTED - Bool - The standby instruments (ISIS) air data is rejected by the PRIM air data monitoring (as above)

A32NX_PRIM_ALL_AIR_DATA_REJECTED - Bool - The PRIMs detect a conflict between the air data sources without being able to tell which one is wrong (two remaining sources that disagree, or two pairs in conflict): all air data rejected, direct law (NAV ALL AIR DATA DISAGREE)

A32NX_PRIM_AOA_{number}_REJECTED - Bool - number: 1, 2 or 3 - The angle of attack of ADR {number} is rejected by the PRIM monitoring (3.6 deg in flight, 8 deg on ground); two or more rejected: NAV AOA DISAGREE and alternate law

A32NX_GPS_{number}_LATITUDE, A32NX_GPS_{number}_LONGITUDE - Arinc429 - The position of the GPS receiver of MMR {number} (1 or 2): valid in NAV mode, no computed data in INIT and ACQ, failure warning when off or failed
A32NX_GPS_{number}_ALTITUDE, A32NX_GPS_{number}_GROUND_SPEED, A32NX_GPS_{number}_TRUE_TRACK - Arinc429, Arinc429, Arinc429 - The GPS altitude, ground speed and true track of the receiver
A32NX_GPS_{number}_HORIZONTAL_FIGURE_OF_MERIT - Arinc429 - The 95 % horizontal accuracy (HFOM) of the receiver position, from the geometry of the satellites tracked
A32NX_GPS_{number}_HORIZONTAL_INTEGRITY_LIMIT - Arinc429 - The horizontal integrity limit (HIL) of the receiver position; no computed data with fewer than five satellites
A32NX_GPS_{number}_SATELLITES - Arinc429 - The number of satellites tracked (in ACQ and NAV), from the nominal 24-slot GPS constellation at the sim UTC time
A32NX_GPS_{number}_MODE - Number - The receiver mode

head: Value
Mode
rows: ALTAID (three satellites and the ADR altitude)
AIDED (coasting on the IR data, up to two minutes)

items: A32NX_ADIRS_ADR_{number}_FAULT_WARN_DISCRETE - Bool - The ADR FAULT discrete of ADIRU {number}: a fault is detected in its air data reference part (ADR FAULT light). False while the ADIRU is not supplied (AC and DC busbars, see a380_systems navigation.rs) or its mode selector is OFF. The FWS reads the ADR fail bit of A32NX_ADIRS_ADR_{number}_DISCRETE_WORD_1 instead.
A32NX_ADIRS_EXTERNAL_HORN - Bool - Written by the common ADIRS overhead panel (A320 external horn of an ADIRU on batteries). Always false on the A380X: its IRs have no battery supply.

A32NX_ADIRS_IR_{number}_GPIRS_LATITUDE, A32NX_ADIRS_IR_{number}_GPIRS_LONGITUDE - Arinc429 - The GPIRS (hybrid GPS/IRS) position of IR {number}: valid when the IR is in NAV and has a GPS receiver in NAV
A32NX_ADIRS_IR_{number}_GPIRS_FIGURE_OF_MERIT, A32NX_ADIRS_IR_{number}_GPIRS_INTEGRITY_LIMIT - Arinc429 - The accuracy (HFOM) and the horizontal integrity limit (HIL) of the GPIRS position

A32NX_ADIRS_IR_{number}_GPIRS_SOURCE - Number - The GPS receiver the IR uses (1 or 2, 0 for none): GPS 1 for IR 1, GPS 2 for IR 2, IR 3 by the ATT HDG selector (GPS 2 on F/O 3); when one receiver is rejected, every IR uses the other
A32NX_GNSS_UTC_UNIX_SECONDS - Number (seconds) - The sim UTC date and time as seconds since 1 January 1970 0000 UTC, for the GPS constellation

A32NX_MMR_{number}_LOC_IS_VALID, A32NX_MMR_{number}_GS_IS_VALID - Bool - number: 1 or 2 - The localizer (glide slope) signal of the ILS receiver of MMR {number} is valid. MMR 1 is the sim NAV 3, MMR 2 NAV 4. Written by systems.wasm (fbw-common navigation/ils.rs). The F/O PFD reads MMR 2; the CAPT PFD keeps the A32NX_RADIO_RECEIVER_* variables (MMR 1)

A32NX_MMR_{number}_LOC_DEVIATION, A32NX_MMR_{number}_GS_DEVIATION - Number in degrees - The localizer (glide slope) deviation of the ILS receiver of MMR {number}, the sim signal (NAV RADIAL ERROR, NAV GLIDE SLOPE ERROR), not corrected for the back beam: the contract of A32NX_RADIO_RECEIVER_LOC_DEVIATION and A32NX_RADIO_RECEIVER_GS_DEVIATION without the calculated ILS signals option

A32NX_FLS_LOC_IS_VALID, A32NX_FLS_GS_IS_VALID - Bool - The F-LOC (F-G/S) deviation of the FLS is valid: an FLS beam is defined (A32NX_FM_FLS_BEAM_VALID) and the aircraft is ahead of its anchor point within 100 NM; F-LOC only when the beam replaces the localizer (A32NX_FM_FLS_LATERAL)

A32NX_FLS_LOC_DEVIATION, A32NX_FLS_GS_DEVIATION - Number in degrees - The F-LOC (F-G/S) deviation from the FMS position and the barometric altitude, with the sign and scale of A32NX_RADIO_RECEIVER_LOC_DEVIATION (A32NX_RADIO_RECEIVER_GS_DEVIATION). On an FLS approach the flight guidance receives these in place of the ILS deviations
A32NX_FLS_LATERAL_ACTIVE, A32NX_FLS_VERTICAL_ACTIVE - Bool - The LOC (G/S) modes fly the FLS beam: F-LOC (F-G/S). LAND does not arm or engage on an FLS approach

`L:A380X_ISIS_CONFIGURATION` - Enum - Set by the MODE pb of either ISIS, which goes to the next configuration (SFD/SND reconfiguration, A380 FCOM DSC-34-10-20-20-10). The other ISIS controls act on the display of their ISIS. - Back to 0 at each power-up of the ISIS (after the unit has gone off, not after a short power loss). The FCOM is silent on it: a design choice.

blocks.text: The oxygen bottles and cabin valves of the systems model (a380_systems oxygen.rs).

items: A32NX_OXYGEN_CREW_BOTTLE_PRESSURE - PSI - The pressure of the cockpit oxygen bottle (DOOR/OXY SD, OXY CKPT BOTTLE PRESS LO)
A32NX_OXYGEN_CABIN_BOTTLE_PRESSURE - PSI - The pressure of the cabin oxygen bottles (DOOR/OXY SD, OXY CABIN BOTTLE PRESS LO)
A32NX_OXYGEN_CABIN_VALVE_CLOSED - Bool - A cabin oxygen regulator supply valve is closed (OXY CABIN VLV CLOSED)
A32NX_PNEU_ENG_{number}_INTERMEDIATE_TRANSDUCER_PRESSURE - Psi - Pressure measured at the intermediate pressure transducer at engine {number}, -1 if no output

A32NX_PNEU_ENG_{number}_OVERHEAT - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - The CPIOM-A bleed overtemperature: above 260 °C up to 45 PSI, above 245 °C over 45 PSI, for more than 55 s (FCOM DSC-36-10-20). Held while the ENG BLEED pb-sw is in AUTO; it closes the bleed valve and the HP valve. Written by the systems WASM (a380_systems pneumatic.rs)

A32NX_PNEU_ENG_{number}_OVERPRESSURE - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - The CPIOM-A bleed overpressure: above 60 PSI up to 245 °C, above 45 PSI over 245 °C, for more than 15 s (FCOM DSC-36-10-20). Held while the ENG BLEED pb-sw is in AUTO; it closes the bleed valve
A32NX_PNEU_ENG_{number}_PR_VALVE_DISAGREE - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - The engine bleed valve is out of its commanded position for 10 s (ENG BLEED pb-sw FAULT light, FCOM DSC-36-20)

A32NX_PNEU_ENG_{number}_BLEED_LEAK - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - A leak of the engine bleed duct in the pylon is detected (above 180 °C, FCOM DSC-36-10-60). Held while the ENG BLEED pb-sw is in AUTO; it closes the bleed valve and, at AUTO, the crossbleed valve of its side (and the center one for engine 1 or 4)

A32NX_PNEU_{zone}_WING_LEAK - Bool - {zone} - L_OUTR - L_INR - R_INR - R_OUTR - A bleed leak in the wing zone is detected (above 124 °C, FCOM DSC-36-10-60). The zone goes with the engine 1, 2, 3 or 4: its ENG BLEED pb-sw holds it, and it closes the bleed valve of that engine as the pylon leak does

A32NX_PNEU_APU_BLEED_LEAK - Bool - A leak of the APU bleed duct is detected (above 124 °C, FCOM DSC-36-10-60, AIR APU BLEED LEAK). Held while the APU BLEED pb-sw is ON (its FAULT light); it closes the APU bleed valve and the APU isolation valve. Written by the systems WASM (a380_systems pneumatic.rs)

A32NX_PNEU_PACK_{number}_LEAK - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - A leak in the pack bay is detected (above 124 °C, AIR PACK 1(2) LEAK). Held while the PACK pb-sw is ON (its FAULT light); it closes the two pack valves of the pack and the hot-air valve of the same number

A32NX_PNEU_HOT_AIR_{number}_LEAK - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - A leak of the hot-air ducts of the hot-air valve is detected (above 124 °C, AIR HOT AIR 1(2) LEAK). Held while the HOT AIR pb-sw is ON (its FAULT light); it closes that hot-air valve

A32NX_PNEU_FWD_CARGO_DUCT_LEAK - Bool - A leak of the forward cargo bleed duct is detected (above 124 °C, AIR FWD CARGO DUCT LEAK). Held while the HOT AIR 1 pb-sw is ON (its FAULT light); it closes the hot-air valve 1

A32NX_PNEU_ENG_{number}_OVERPRESSURE_VALVE_CLOSED - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - The overpressure valve downstream of the engine bleed valve is closed: it closes above 85 PSI and opens again below 55 PSI (FCOM DSC-36-10-20), e.g. with a bleed valve stuck open at high power

A32NX_PNEU_XBLEED_VALVE_{valve}_AUTO_CONTROL_LOST - Bool - {valve} - L - C - R - The crossbleed valve no longer gets the AUTO logic: both CPIOM-A of its pair are lost (CPIOM-A1/A2 for the left valve, A3/A4 for the center and right valves). The XBLEED selector OPEN/CLOSE still moves it. For AIR XBLEED FAULT ("Is no longer controlled automatically by the bleed controller")

A32NX_PNEU_XBLEED_VALVE_{valve}_ABNORMAL_POSITION - Bool - {valve} - L - C - R - The crossbleed valve is not in the position its motor was last commanded to, for 10 s (flyPad crossbleed valve stuck failures). For AIR XBLEED FAULT ("Has an abnormal position"). Written by the systems WASM (a380_systems pneumatic.rs)

A32NX_PNEU_XBLEED_VALVE_{valve}_MANUAL_CONTROL_LOST - Bool - {valve} - L - C - R - The manual control motor of the crossbleed valve has no supply (DC ESS): the XBLEED selector no longer moves it. For AIR XBLEED FAULT (XBLEED ... AUTO)

A32NX_PNEU_ENG_{number}_HP_VALVE_NOT_OPEN - Bool - {number} - 1 - 2 - 3 - 4 - The HP valve stays closed for 5 s while the CPIOM-A commands it open (flyPad HP valve stuck closed failure). For AIR ENG 1(2)(3)(4) HP VLV NOT OPEN

A32NX_PNEU_{zone}_LEAK_DET_FAULT - Bool - {zone} - ENG_1 - ENG_2 - ENG_3 - ENG_4 - L_OUTR_WING - L_INR_WING - R_INR_WING - R_OUTR_WING - APU - PACK_1 - PACK_2 - HOT_AIR_1 - HOT_AIR_2 - FWD_CARGO - AFT_CARGO - The bleed leak detection of the duct zone is lost: both loops of the zone (flyPad dual loop failure), or both bleed leak detection systems. A leak of the zone is then neither detected nor isolated. For AIR LEAK DET FAULT

A32NX_ASU_TURNED_ON - Bool - An HP ground air cart is connected and supplies air (flyPad Ground > Services, Air Starter Unit). Read by the systems WASM: the air enters the bleed ducts on the engine 1 side through the non-return valve of the HP ground connector (FCOM DSC-36-10-40)

A32NX_APU_BLEED_AIR_VALVE_COMMANDED_OPEN - Bool - True when the APU ECB commands the APU bleed valve open (the stuck failures 36060 closed / 36061 open do not change it). The FWS compares it with A32NX_APU_BLEED_AIR_VALVE_OPEN for AIR APU BLEED FAULT, valve abnormally open (closed) (A380 FCOM PRO-ABN-ECAM-10-36; ApuBleedFaultAlerts.ts). Written by the systems WASM (a380_systems apu_bleed_air_valve.rs)

blocks.text: -A32NX_AFDX___REACHABLE

items: Bool - Indicates if the AFDX switch with the source id can reach the switch with the destination id
A32NX_AFDX_SWITCH__FAILURE - Bool - Indicates if a specific AFDX switch is in a failure mode
A32NX_AFDX_SWITCH__AVAIL - Bool - Indicates if a specific AFDX switch is available: powered, and neither A32NX_AFDX_SWITCH__FAILURE nor its flyPad failure (ATA 42, ids 42001-42019) is set
A32NX_CPIOM__FAILURE - Bool - Indicates if a specific CPIOM system is in a failure mode
A32NX_CPIOM__AVAIL - Bool - Indicates if a specific CPIOM system is available: powered, and neither A32NX_CPIOM__FAILURE nor its flyPad failure (ATA 42, ids 42201-42264) is set
A32NX_IOM__FAILURE - Bool - Indicates if a specific IOM system is in a failure mode

A32NX_IOM__AVAIL - Bool - Indicates if a specific IOM system is available: powered, and neither A32NX_IOM__FAILURE nor its flyPad failure (ATA 42, ids 42101-42108) is set - The FWS AVIONICS NETWORK alerts (systems-host CpiomC/FlightWarningSystem/AvionicsNetworkAlerts.ts) count the AFDX switches and IOMs whose _FAILURE L:var or flyPad failure is set, not the unpowered ones

A32NX_OVHD_NSS_DATA_TO_AVNCS_TOGGLE - Bool - The NSS DATA TO AVNCS pb-sw: 1 = normal (released, the NSS and the avionics exchange data both ways; the value of every flight file), 0 = OFF (pressed in, OFF light; the SCIs pass data only from the avionics to the NSS). OFF gives the FWS alert COM NSS DATA TO AVNCS XFR FAULT (A380 FCOM DSC-46-20-20-80, PRO-ABN-ECAM-10-46). OFF also stops the AOC downlinks (messages and requests), the uplinks still come in (systems host CpiomD/atsu.ts). With OFF (or both SCIs lost) the COMPANY MSG memos and voice no longer reach the FWS, the eLogbook loses its ground link and the OIT REFUEL entries no longer reach the FQMS

A32NX_OVHD_NSS_GATELINK_OFF - Bool - The NSS GATELINK pb-sw: 0 = released (the Terminal Area Wireless LAN Unit is on; the default of every flight file), 1 = pressed in (OFF light, TWLU off). With 1 the gatelink to the ground is lost: the FLT OPS EXPORT BOX reads GATELINK NOT AVAIL and keeps its data in the outbox, and the LOAD BOX gets no new data on the ground. Read by the OIT (A380 FCOM DSC-46-20-20-80)

A32NX_COMPANY_MSG_PRNTR_COUNT - Number - The unread company messages that wait for their automatic printout on the pedestal printer (the AOC prints the received weather reports by itself). Written by the systems host (CpiomD/AocAutoPrint.ts); above 0 the COMPANY MSG memo reads COMPANY MSG:PRNTR (A380 FCOM DSC-46-40-20)

A32NX_NSS_ANSU_{index}_IS_HEALTHY - Bool - NSS AVNCS ANSU 1(2) healthy: powered, not failed (flyPad 46001, 46002), not reset (RESET panel NSS AVNCS), NSS master on, and the aircraft not powered down (each ANSU shuts down by itself 10 s after the AC busbar that feeds it is lost (AC 2, AC 1 or AC EMER, AC ESS), batteries alone do not keep it). Written by the OIT (AircraftNetworkServerUnit.ts); the AOC (systems host CpiomD/atsu.ts) runs while one of them is healthy (A380 FCOM DSC-46-40-10-20: "In the case of an ANSU 1 failure, ANSU 2 provides the AOC application")

A380X_ATC_FUNCTION_AVAIL - Bool - The ATC datalink function (CPDLC, ADS, ATIS) runs: CPIOM D1 available and the ATC RESET pb of the RESET panel pushed in. Written by the systems host (CpiomD/AtcDatalink.ts); false: MAILBOX NOT AVAIL in the SD mailbox, ATC COM NOT AVAIL for 5 s when an ATC COM page is selected with the KCCU ATC COM key (A380 FCOM PRO-SUP-46 ATC RESET, DSC-46-10-20-30)

A380X_ACD_{side}_{key} - Bool - Set to 1 by a press of the key of the Additional Control Device (the 8-key pad beside the OIT, A380 FCOM DSC-46-20-20-60), never reset; the key itself goes to the OIT as H:A380X_LAPTOP_KEYBOARD_L(R)_ (keyboard.xml) - {side} = CPT or FO - {key} = OIS_XFR, OIS_MENU, ESC, ENTER, UP, DOWN, LEFT or RIGHT
A32NX_APU_N2 - `Arinc429Word` - The APU's N2 rotations per minute in percentage of the maximum RPM
A32NX_APU_FUEL_USED - `Arinc429Word` - The APU fuel used, in kilograms

A32NX_APU_IS_AUTO_SHUTDOWN - Bool - True after an automatic shutdown of the APU electronic control box (ECB) for a reason other than a fire: fuel low pressure, DC power lost (start motor supply, or the ECB's DC supply above N 70 %), ECB failure, overspeed, low oil pressure, high oil temperature on the ground (A380 FCOM DSC-49-40; the last four from the ATA 49 flyPad failures). Drives APU FAULT

A32NX_APU_LOW_OIL_LEVEL - `Arinc429Word` - The APU ECB detects a low APU oil level: on the ground with the APU not running (flyPad failure "APU oil level low", 49005; common ECB, see the A32NX doc). Shows the pulsing OIL LVL LO on the APU SD page (A380 FCOM DSC-49-20)

blocks.text: The doors and slides management system (DSMS, systems-host Misc/DoorsAndSlidesManagement.ts) publishes what it detects from the ATA 52 flyPad failures. A {DOORS} bit field has bit n set for the passenger door at sim interactive point n: 0-9 MAIN 1L, 1R ... 5L, 5R, 10-15 UPPER 1L, 1R ... 3L, 3R.

items: A32NX_DSMS_DOOR_ACTUATOR_FAULT - {DOORS} bit field - The opening/closing actuator of the door is failed (DOOR ... ACTUATOR FAULT)
A32NX_DSMS_FLIGHT_LOCK_FAULT - {DOORS} bit field - The flight lock actuator of the door is failed (DOOR ... FLIGHT LOCK FAULT)

A32NX_DSMS_FLIGHT_LOCK_ENGAGED - {DOORS} bit field - The flight lock locks the door handle: from 65 kt and below FL 240, released when the door is no longer monitored; a failed flight lock actuator stays where it was
A32NX_DSMS_LATCH_MONITORING_FAULT - {DOORS} bit field - The LDC can no longer monitor the door latches (DOOR ... LATCH MONITORING FAULT)
A32NX_DSMS_LDC_FAULT - {DOORS} bit field - The local door controller (LDC) of the door is failed (DOOR ... POS DET FAULT, DOOR POS DET FAULT when all the LDCs of one side are failed)

A32NX_DSMS_DOOR_POSITION_INVALID - {DOORS} bit field - The DSMS does not know the door position (failed LDC, or the three DSMS channels failed): the DOOR/OXY SD page shows the door not valid and the FWS has no DOOR ... NOT CLOSED alert for it
A32NX_DSMS_SLIDE_FAULT - {DOORS} bit field - The escape slide is not ready or is failed (DOOR ... SLIDE FAULT, amber S on the DOOR/OXY SD page)
A32NX_DSMS_SLIDE_LENGTHENING_FAULT - Bit field, bit 0 MAIN 1L, bit 1 MAIN 1R - The sill height sensors are failed, no slide extension (DOOR MAIN 1L(R) SLIDE LENGTHENING FAULT)
A32NX_DSMS_CHANNELS_FAILED - Number, 0 to 3 - The failed DSMS channels: 2 or 3 give DOOR POS DET FAULT; with 3 no door is monitored
A32NX_DSMS_RESIDUAL_PRESS_DET_FAULT - Bool - The ASPSU is failed: no residual cabin differential pressure detection at the doors (DOOR RESIDUAL DIFF PRESS DET FAULT)
A32NX_COCKPIT_DOOR_SW_SELECTIONS - Number - Counts the CKPT DOOR sw selections to LOCK or UNLOCK (the switch is momentary)

A32NX_COCKPIT_DOOR_EMER_OPENING_IN_PROGRESS - Bool - The cabin crew entered the emergency access code (flyPad ATA 52 "Cockpit door emergency access request") and the flight crew has not answered with the CKPT DOOR sw yet; without an answer the door unlocks by itself for 5 s after 30 s (L:A32NX_COCKPIT_DOOR_LOCKED). Drives DOOR CKPT DOOR EMER OPENING IN PROGRESS

L:A32NX_OVHD_FADEC_{ENG} - The FADEC GND PWR pb of the engine is ON (latched). Setting it ON on the ground supplies the FADEC from the aircraft network for 10 min (the ENG SD page shows the engine parameters); the FADEC is also supplied 15 min after the aircraft power-up (A380 FCOM DSC-70-20-10) - {ENG} = 1, 2, 3, 4

A32NX_AIRLINER_TO_DERATE - Number (percent) - The DOx derated takeoff of the MFD PERF T.O panel (DERATED D04, D08, D12, D16, D20, D24): the thrust reduction in percent (4 to 24), 0 when TOGA or FLEX is selected (A380 FCOM DSC-70-20-40). The FADECs (fadec_a380x TakeoffDerate_A380X.hpp) write the derated rating as the FLX limit and the FADEC models of the fbw module take their FLX path for it (TakeoffDerate.h); the E/WD shows the level in place of FLX, the FWS takes the FLX/MCT detent as take-off power and TOGA as ENG THR LEVERS NOT SET. Written by the MFD (MFD/shared/TakeoffDerate.ts)

A32NX_AIRLINER_CLIMB_DERATE - Number - The DERATED CLB entry of the MFD PERF CLB panel of the active flight plan: the derated climb level 1 to 3 (DCL1 to DCL3), 0 for NONE. Written by the FMC (MFD/shared/ClimbDerate.ts), read by the FADECs (fadec_a380x DeratedClimb_A380X.hpp)
